defects.description: The midpoint comparison uses `x <= a[mid]`; a rightmost insertion point (per the docstring) requires `x < a[mid]`, so equal keys are routed into the left subrange rather than the right (bisect_left instead of bisect_right).
paraphrases: `x <= a[mid]` should be `x < a[mid]`: with `<=` the routine follows bisect_left semantics, not the documented rightmost insertion.
Using `<=` sends equal elements into the left half, contradicting the docstring's 'just after the rightmost x'.
The midpoint comparison operator is `<=` where rightmost-insertion logic requires `<`.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `x < a[mid]`. Real (wrong side for duplicate keys), findable against the docstring's rightmost-insertion semantics, distinct from the other defects. Described statically since the co-present non-termination defect (d3) masks any runtime observation.

defects.description: The initial upper bound is `len(a) - 1`, so the last element (index len(a)-1) is excluded from the searched range; the default should be `len(a)`.
paraphrases: The default `hi` should be `len(a)`, not `len(a) - 1`; the final element is left outside the search interval.
Off-by-one in the upper bound: `len(a) - 1` drops the last index, so an insertion point of len(a) is unreachable.
`hi` starts one too low, excluding the last element from consideration.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `hi = len(a)`. Real (last element excluded from the range), findable because the docstring's `bisect_right([1,3,3,5],5)` must reach index 4, distinct.

defects.description: The else branch sets `lo = mid` instead of `lo = mid + 1`, so when `x` belongs to the right half the loop cannot make progress and never terminates.
paraphrases: `lo = mid` should be `lo = mid + 1`; without the increment the search interval never shrinks and the loop hangs.
Non-termination: on the right-half branch `lo` is not advanced past `mid`.
The binary search can loop forever because `lo` is reassigned to `mid` rather than `mid + 1`.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `lo = mid + 1`. Real (infinite loop), findable by checking loop progress, distinct from the bound and comparison defects.
